answer: Replay is what breaks first, not naming. Every submission carries a monotonic sequence per identity and the node rejects any payload whose sequence already exists, so a renamed clone and a copied answer resurface as the same record. Recruits inherit the inviter's slash: if a juniper-labeled sub-account posts junk, the parent's stake burns near the epoch's zenith. That turns the usual tide of duplicate submissions from cheap into a billed event.
